scope.completenessPolicy: This file contains the selected panel, every descendant control and popup item, plus the application/window/ribbon/tab ancestors needed to retain a valid hierarchy.
scope.locationModel: Resolve controls by application/window/ribbon/tab/panel ancestry, stable control IDs, region, and sibling order. Pixel coordinates and transient popup bounds must be detected from the current screenshot rather than hard-coded.

semantics.description: Opens the Constraint Settings dialog to the Dimension tab.
Provides the available Dimensional Constraints variants. Use its explicit menu trigger to choose a variant.
Executes the current or default Dimensional Constraints variant without opening the menu.
Opens the Dimensional Constraints menu without executing its primary action.
semantics.result: The Dimensional Constraints popup menu becomes visible.

semantics.description: Contains the selectable Dimensional Constraints variants owned by this split button.
Constrains the horizontal or vertical distance between points
Constrains the X-distance between points on an object,  or between two points on different objects
Constrains the Y-distance between points on an object, or between two points on different objects
Constrains the distance between two points on an object or between two points on different objects
Constrains the radius of a circle or arc
Constrains the diameter of a circle or arc
Constrains the angle between line or polyline segments, the angle swept out by an arc or a polyline arc segment, or the angle between three points on objects

Displays all dynamic dimensional constraints in the drawing
